title: Assistant Manager, Human Resources Business Partner
jobDescription: Situs AMC is where the best and most passionate people come to transform our client’s businesses and their own careers. Whether you’re a real estate veteran, a passionate technologist, or looking to get your start, join us as we work together to realize opportunities for everyone, we proudly serve. At Situs AMC, we are looking to match your unique experience with one of our amazing careers, so that we can help you realize your potential and career growth within the Real Estate Industry. If you are someone who can be yourself, advocate for others, stay nimble, dream big, own every outcome, and think global but act local – come join our team! Act as the primary HR contact for employees and managers within assigned business units throughout the employee lifecycle. Partner with assigned business unit leaders to understand team dynamics and provide HR guidance on employee relations, performance, and development. Support the implementation of HR policies and ensure compliance with internal procedures and legal regulations. Assist in the facilitation of performance management processes including goal setting, reviews, and talent assessments. Use tools like Culture Index and Activ Trak to monitor and enhance employee productivity and engagement for assigned business units. Generate and analyze reports in Workday to support decision-making related to compensation, roles, and workforce planning for assigned business units. Drive employee engagement initiatives through MTC, ERGs, and Vo E programs for assigned business units Conduct exit interviews and analyze trends to provide actionable insights to assigned business unit leadership. Collaborate with HR Risk & Compliance to ensure adherence to employment laws and company policies. Provide guidance on performance management including coaching, career development, and disciplinary actions for assigned business unites Support HR operations including unemployment claims, benefits queries, job description updates, offboarding, and employment verifications for assigned business units. Assist in investigations related to employee complaints and recommend appropriate actions. Coordinate with employees on leave and attendance management for assigned business units. Lead or support special HR projects as assigned by HR leadership Other activities as may be assigned by your manager

Invoicing: Read and interpret contracts to understand pricing, units, and products for accurate invoicing. Perform calculations to generate invoices, ensuring accuracy and adherence to contractual terms. Determine due dates for invoices based on contractual agreements and payment terms. Month-end Activities: Execute OTC month-end closing processes efficiently and accurately. Perform accruals and deferrals as necessary to ensure accurate financial reporting. Reconcile customer accounts and resolve discrepancies. Coordinate with internal teams such as sales, finance, and operations to obtain necessary information for invoicing. Collaborate with external stakeholders, including customers, to resolve billing inquiries and discrepancies. Research and resolve inquiries from external and internal parties. Assist with preparation of supporting files for work in process entries prepared monthly Review contracts to ensure invoices are billed in accordance with contractual terms Coordinate collections with the Staff Accountant and various operational teams. Prepare month end WIP report Support departmental initiatives including but not limited to process documentation and system implementations Ad hoc reporting as necessary Ensure security and confidentiality of data Such other activities as may be assigned by your manager

jobDescription: Situs AMC is where the best and most passionate people come to transform our client’s businesses and their own careers. Review loan files for completeness and accuracy including but not limited to calculation and verification of income & assets, evaluation of credit reports, purchase contracts, appraisals, title commitments, VOE, tax returns, divorce decrees, and other loan pertinent compliance documentation. Evaluate debt & loan-to-value ratios, credit score, property valuation and various other factors. Determine and document loan conditions, communicate requirements, and/or decisions. Such other activities as may be assigned by your manager.
